class.name: FSProjectScripts
class.brief_description: Parser-level project script discovery for FoundryScript test runners.

method.name: get_script_descriptor
method.description: Returns a descriptor for a single script path. Returns a null [code]Ref[/code] when the file does not exist.

method.name: list_scripts_under
method.description: Enumerates FoundryScript files under [param root_path] using engine directory access. Results are sorted lexicographically by path for reproducible CI output. Each script yields a descriptor, including files that fail to index.
